The '''A/KT Wing Commander armored flight suit''' was an [[Armor/Legends|armored]] [[Flight suit/Legends|flight suit]] produced by [[Ayelixe/Krongbing Textiles/Legends|Ayelixe/Krongbing Textiles]]. The suit sold for 1,500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and was composed primarily of synthetic textiles, with [[ferro-ceramic]] plates and gel inserts providing protection to the wearer.<ref name="Stay on Target" />
